podcast.body: This song was the number one alt-rock track in the world as the 2010s decade began, a position it had maintained since mid-October 2009. It represented one of Muse's biggest singles in their career. "One of the biggest singles of muse's career."

podcast.body: This song was part of Muse's setlist when they headlined Coachella in 2010, sharing the top billing with Gorillaz and Jay-Z, marking a period when Coachella was beginning its shift towards pop and hip-hop. "Muse and uprising, one of the songs they played during their Coachella set in 2010."
